profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at FreeWill

positions.title: Customer Support Representative - Dornsife Technology Services
positions.description:
• Assisted end users at front desk and through phone, providing technical support and creating and updating accurate help desk tickets
• Helped maintain and update computers and set up and deploy loaner devices and accessories

company.name: USC Dornsife College of Letters, Arts and Sciences

positions.title: Course Grader
positions.description: • Graded programming assignments in Java and C/C++ for CSCI 455 - Introduction to Programming Systems Design

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Redesigned and revamped pages of a web application that monitors machines in an industrial setting
• Developed new components with React, Bootstrap, Plotly, and the Canvas API and integrated them with DynamoDB and Amazon S3
• Implemented serverless backend features with AWS Lambda functions and Amazon API gateways

positions.title: Blockchain Research Intern
positions.description:
• Led a team that researched blockchain mechanics for the CryptoKitties Ethereum game, developed a social network model from blockchain data using Python and Spark GraphFrames, and analyzed the model for patterns using Spark and the Gephi visualization tool
• Enhanced, tested, and debugged the graph construction and blockchain scraping code
• Scraped 100,000 blocks from the Ethereum blockchain using Web3.py and a Python web crawler
• Designed and deployed a MongoDB Atlas cloud database for storing the raw transaction data and used PyMongo to integrate the database with the Python codebase

projects.title: Online Movie Database Website & Android Application
projects.description:
• Designed movie database applications for browser and mobile using the TMDB API where users can look up and view movie and TV show details and save movies and shows to a watchlist
• Developed a responsive web application with Angular, Bootstrap, Express, and Node.js that is compatible with desktop, tablet, and mobile screen sizes and deployed it to the Google Cloud Platform
• Built a companion Android application in Java with a Node.js backend deployed to Google Cloud

projects.title: Ecommerce Retail Website
projects.description:
• Designed and built an ecommerce website with Django, PostgreSQL, JavaScript, AJAX, and REST allowing user to update account settings, browse products, add items to shopping cart, and checkout
• Implemented tracking feature that notifies user of order’s shipping status and uses Google Maps API to display package’s location on a live map
